title.narrative: HEARD - Health of Ethiopian Animals for Rural Development - component 2 - ILRI/EVA

description.narrative: In line with the framework of HEARD, this project to be implemented by ILRI jointly with EVA will focus on Result 2 (technical competences (knowledge, skills and attitude) and incentives for veterinary service providers improved to deliver better and rationalised services) and thus will provide the enabling environment in terms of testing and provide evidence of impact of PPPs and provide capacity development related to activities in the regional grants addressing Result 1 and the MoALR grant addressing Result 3. Public-private partnership models for delivery of veterinary services have been identified as a promising solution to address current bottlenecks in animal health service delivery in Ethiopia
